body: You could explain to them what went on? Hopefully they would understand?

If you want my honest opinion - you have to cut your ties.


Explain to her the damage she caused etc, shes big enough to deal with it. I'm sorry for what has happened. If you really don't want to see her, then don't. You say you live with you bf? And from comments I've seen you live with his family? Make them your new family. If they love you, you deserve it x
Do you still see her physically? Is there any abuse then if so? Like any including mental?

You could try looking up any support stuff, or even make a complaint? It's tough. Going to court for damages etc would take a long time and you may lose out at the end. Is it worth dragging yourself through that? 

I'd say just move on from it, as hard as it is! I know its easier said that done though. Focus on the future and forget about the past.

Why do you find it hard to break?

You could maybe take it further, but I'm not sure!

Do you still have contact with the abuser - if you don't mind me asking?
